en: Two-sided illustrated postcard. The picture side shows three small monochrome photographs framed with floral decoration: at left a tree‑lined path along a fortification labeled "Graft."; in the center a city gate and wall scene labeled "Waisenhausgässer‑Thor."; at right a canal with houses and trees labeled "Tömös‑Kanal." Beneath the center photo is the printed caption "Gruss aus Kronstadt." The card is heavily overprinted with handwritten German text and dated 4.VI.1909. The address side has the printed Hungarian word "LEVELEZŐ‑LAP." at the top, a green 5‑fillér Hungarian stamp, multiple postmarks, and handwritten address to "Fräulein Mathilde Hebbel" in "Hermannstadt".
